shared_elements: incised linear motifs on stone surface
justification: A shows only a few faint, isolated incised lines and arcs with no identifiable subject, whereas B is a monumental anthropomorphic figure with a head, face and a torso covered by ordered relief motifs including concentric rings/discs, a girdle-like band and a large central disc. The only correspondence is that both bear shallow linear carving on stone, which is a generic trait; there is no shared figural motif, relationship or layout.
